standard.summary: Bucket 分辨率的枚举步长（像素）。决定生成多少个不同分辨率的桶，值越小桶越细，图像裁剪损失越少。
standard.effect: steps=64 = 分辨率以 64 像素为步长（256/320/384...）；steps=32 = 桶更密，图像更精准分组。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 64 适合大多数场景。数据集比例差异大（如同时有 1:1 和 16:9 图）时可降低到 32。
standard.avoidWhen: steps 过小（<16）会生成大量极少用到的桶，内存开销增加且意义不大。

standard_en.summary: The enumeration step, in pixels, for bucket resolutions. It decides how many distinct buckets exist: a smaller value gives finer buckets and less cropping loss.
standard_en.effect: steps=64 = resolutions in 64-pixel increments (256/320/384...); steps=32 = denser buckets and more accurate grouping.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default of 64 suits most cases. Drop to 32 when aspect ratios in the dataset vary widely (1:1 and 16:9 images together, say).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Too small a step (<16) generates a great many buckets that barely get used, costing memory for little gain.

advanced.principle: 桶生成算法：从最小分辨率到最大分辨率，以 steps 为间隔枚举所有面积接近 target_resolution² 的分辨率对。每张图像被分配到面积差异最小的桶。
advanced.tradeoffs: 步长越小 = 桶越多 = 图像裁剪损失越少，但相同桶内图像数量更少（batch 内相同分辨率的图更难凑齐）。

advanced_en.principle: Bucket generation: from the minimum to the maximum resolution, enumerates resolution pairs at step intervals whose area is close to target_resolution². Each image goes to the bucket with the smallest area difference.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Smaller steps = more buckets = less crop loss, but fewer images per bucket (harder to fill a batch with same-resolution images).
